facts.claim: Safeco companies ceased new legacy HO-6 condominium business in California effective 2025-01-01 and began nonrenewing existing legacy HO-6 policies effective 2026-01-01.
facts.source: California Department of Insurance 2024 Annual Report

facts.claim: Liberty Mutual retired the Safeco brand effective 2026-04-25 and stated that existing policies were not impacted by the name change.
facts.source: Liberty Mutual Insurance Retires Safeco Brand

allowedPublicClaims: Documented legacy HO-6 condo program withdrawal in California
Safeco brand retired into Liberty Mutual
Brand transition itself did not cancel existing policies
